summary.root_cause_text: Ops changed payment_provider_url to internal://payments-v2 (provider migration), which is unreachable. The worker kept 'processing' orders without payment.
recommended: Confirm that payments-v2 is reachable and correctly addressed before retrying the migration.
Alert on payment provider call failures, which are currently logged only at DEBUG.

events.text:
version: v1.3
payment_provider_url: internal://payments-v2
queue_max: 1000
worker_count: 1
sync_interval_s: 5
Orders are still failing, so I'm reverting the provider URL to v1.
payment_provider_url: 'internal://payments-v2' -> 'internal://payments-v1'. Confirmed: the service is now using the new value.
All business invariants green (health, payments, queue, worker, ledger, errors, latency).

root_causes: Ops changed payment_provider_url to internal://payments-v2 (provider migration), which is unreachable. The worker kept 'processing' orders without payment.
evidence: DEBUG payment: provider call failed: payment provider unreachable at internal://payments-v2 (420+ times)
recent_changes: 2 min ago config payment_provider_url payments-v1 -> payments-v2 by ops
Alert: 11 of 27 orders had no payment at first; the count grew to 436 by reprocessing time
args.impact: The unpaid count grew from 11 of 27 orders at alert time to 436 orders by the time I reprocessed. The reprocess recovered all 436 (SAR 71361.91 and USD 36723.7, total_sar 209075.79). The alert showed 11 unpaid orders worth total_sar 5149.07. No orders were dropped and the ledger had no integrity failures.
recommended_actions: Confirm that payments-v2 is reachable and correctly addressed before retrying the migration.

args.summary: An ops config change pointed the payment provider at an unreachable payments-v2 endpoint, so orders were marked processed with no payment. I reverted the URL to payments-v1 and reprocessed all unpaid orders. All invariants are now green.
